[[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]'s '''Sith Empire''' was a revived faction of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] that was founded and ruled by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Exar Kun during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. As an ambitious and power-hungry [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Kun became deeply immersed in the forbidden knowledge of the ancient Sith Lords and during his journey to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] decided to restore the ancient Sith Empire, by toppling the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and crushing the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

The fall of another Jedi Knight ([[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]) to the dark side, the establishment of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult in the prominent and powerful [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]], the corruption of the [[Mecrosa Order]] by Sith teachings in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], and the alliance with the warlike [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] provided Exar Kun, the newly christened [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], with the necessary means to wage a short-lived, but very devastating war against the Republic and the Jedi. However inner tensions, great consolidation of the Jedi forces and betrayal by his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] led to Kun's defeat.

After this Sith Empire's collapse, many of its remnants and former leaders sought to restore it to power; ultimately, it would be resurrected in the form of the new [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

==History==
[[File:Exarkunsithholocron.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Exar Kun discovers a Sith holocron.]]
More than four centuries after the fall of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], the fallen Jedi [[Freedon Nadd]] discovered two artifacts that the [[Jedi Shadow]]s had failed to destroy: the [[Holocron of King Adas]] and the ghost of [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] himself, both of which Nadd used to absorb himself in the teachings of the Sith. After training under the ancient Sith Lord, Nadd destroyed Sadow, proclaiming himself the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and subjugating the world of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], where he ruled as king from the capital of Iziz until his physical demise. However, his spirit still influenced the events on the planet, leading to two great conflicts—the [[Beast Wars]] and the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising|Freedon Nadd Uprising]]—both of which resulted in an unfortunate outcome for the Sith future. Despite his defeat on Onderon, Nadd's teachings would yet lead to a new Sith Empire.

In [[3997 BBY]], a young Jedi known as [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] became curious about the teachings of the Sith. He abandoned his master, [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]], left Dantooine, and journeyed to the planet Onderon, followed by its jungle moon, [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], where he was eventually lured to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] by the ghost of Freedon Nadd. Becoming Nadd's apprentice, he traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where, after discovering ancient Sith artifacts, he acquired even greater Sith powers. Seeing himself as being as powerful as he always desired, he rebelled against his Sith master, destroying Nadd's spirit and becoming the new [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Enveloped in the dark side, Kun elevated himself to the stature of a god, enslaving the local [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] race, deeply immersing himself in [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and magic, and watching the construction of a series of massive [[Massassi Temple|temples]]. The fourth moon of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] thus became one of the strongholds of a future resurrected Sith Empire.

[[File:TOTJDLOTS2-FC.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Krath territory became an integral part of the Sith Empire.]]
Meanwhile, another Jedi, [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], although motivated by good intentions, also began his journey to the dark side. He had become Emperor of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] and leader of the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]], a Sith-inspired cult that had formed after the Freedon Nadd Uprising and had learned much of their power from Sith artifacts that survived the conflict. Even before Qel-Droma joined their ranks, the power-hungry and very hostile Krath had staged a violent military [[Political uprising of the Empress Teta system|coup]] in their native system, crushing all resistance. After declaring [[Krath Holy Crusade|war]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic]] Republic, the Krath carried out a [[Battle of Deneba|brutal attack]] on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which resulted in massive Jedi casualties.

Learning of the Krath, Kun set off to their headquarters located in the [[Iron Citadel/Legends|Iron Citadel]], intent upon eliminating the self-proclaimed followers of the Sith teachings. However, during the [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|lightsaber duel]] between Kun and Qel-Droma, the spirits of a number of long-dead Sith Lords appeared—including that of [[Marka Ragnos]]—putting a stop to their duel. Ragnos named Kun the new Dark Lord of the Sith and Qel-Droma his apprentice, believing that they would restore the [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. Uniting their forces, both Sith Lords vowed to raze the galaxy and destroy both the Republic and the Jedi. This led to a shortly-reborn Sith Empire under their reign that caused great destruction. [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], a heavily-fortified planet in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and the capital of the Krath faction, became the second Sith stronghold.

The [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], which tore the galaxy apart and led to massive casualties, had begun. Kun's and Qel-Droma's first act as Sith Lords was to [[Dark Reaper campaign|consolidate the space]] immediately surrounding the Empress Teta system. To accomplish this goal, Kun used one of the many relics of Naga Sadow's that he had found on Yavin 4—the [[Dark Reaper]]. The superweapon proved an effective tool, succeeding in killing thousands of Republic soldiers and Jedi Knights. A memorable genocide ensued, spreading great fear throughout the galaxy. However, both Sith Lords knew that in order to challenge the Republic's rule over the galaxy and destroy the Jedi Order, they would need a larger Sith army, including more Force-users. Although their military forces consisted of Krath troops and fanatically-loyal Massassi soldiers, and that they had managed to gain some footholds in the galaxy, the Sith Empire appeared to be overstretched by their campaigns.

[[File:Mandalorians_-_TEA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Mandalorian Crusaders pledged all their resources for Exar Kun's Sith Empire.]]
In the first year of the war, the Sith Empire entered into a non-aggression alliance with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], forcing the Republic to [[Battle of Ko Vari (Boonta)|take action]] to remove the new ally of the Sith. Shortly after, a new opportunity for the Sith Empire appeared on the horizon when [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] invaded the Empress Teta system. Supreme commander of the Mandalorian forces, [[Mandalore the Indomitable|Mandalore the Indomitable]], challenged Qel-Droma to a [[duel on Kuar]], promising his allegiance in the case of defeat. The Sith Lord won the honorary battle, with Mandalore and his armies swearing loyalty to the Sith. With the addition of well-trained and disciplined forces, specific resources in terms of war production, and worlds conquered during the Mandalorian Crusade, the Sith Empire expanded greatly and strengthened, allowing the Sith to escalate the war to new heights. Now [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], homeworld of many Mandalorian clans, joined the group of Sith Empire strongholds. In an effort to weaken the Republic, joint Krath and Mandalorian forces launched a series of successful raids against the Republic's shipyards and stole many warships, adding to their already expansive fleets.

Combatting the Jedi Order also seemed to be going very well. Believing that his empire must have a strong and united group of fellow Force-users that would replace the weak and dogmatic Jedi Order, Kun founded the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] and recruited many Jedi into his new Sith organization. Some of them joined of their own free will, while others were corrupted by Sith magic. Over time, the Brotherhood amassed a group that included [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], Krath cultists, and [[Krath Death Witch|Death Witches]], all of whom would take part in the deaths of many Jedi. For example, ex-Jedi Knights, possessed by dark side spirits, were responsible for carrying out [[Sith uprising|mass murder]] of the famous Jedi Masters. As in any war, some opportunistic mercenaries, criminals, smugglers, and collaborators offered their services to the Sith.

The Brotherhood of the Sith also received support from the [[Mecrosa Order|Mecrosa]] Order, which were headquartered in the decadent [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The Order, under the leadership of [[High Lady]] [[Brezwalt III]], began contributing financially to the Sith war effort and sending skilled assassins on secret missions for Kun. Now, the Republic had four aggressive and determined factions to contend with, all in various parts of the galaxy, that were close to toppling the dominant galactic government.

The Sith Empire's odds of winning the war grew increasingly good; however, after months of conquering planets from the Deep Core to the Outer Rim, the [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|Battle of Coruscant]] revealed the first signs of its crumbling: inner tensions, a well-known bad omen. Though Kun managed to kill [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Sidrona]] in front of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], slay Master Vodo-Siosk Baas, rescue his apprentice, Qel-Droma, from [[Trial of Ulic Qel-Droma|imminent]] execution, and plunder the [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] library, the Jedi and the Republic military decided to organize a decisive strike straight at the heart of his empire. After his defection from the Empire, Qel-Droma revealed the secret location of the Brotherhood's main staging center, leading to Kun's [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|defeat]] on Yavin 4 in [[3996 BBY]]. At the same time, the Mandalorian clans were [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|routed]] on Onderon, with their leader, Mandalore the Indomitable, being killed. After these milestone events, the Sith Empire lost its backbone.

[[File:RevanMalak-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Darth Revan and Darth Malak, Sith successors to Exar Kun and Ulic Qel-Droma.]]
With the defeat of the two Sith Lords, neutralization of the Sith powers on Yavin 4, elimination of almost the entire Massassi race, killing of many Brotherhood members, halting of the Mandalorian Crusaders' conquest, and [[Battle of Thule (Great Sith War)|disabling]] the Dark Reaper on [[Thule/Legends|Thule]], all that remained for the Republic and the Jedi were the Empire's two remaining remnants: the Krath and the Mecrosa Order. The first faction had retreated the bulk of its military to the Empress Teta system; however, that move proved to ⠆ a costly mistake. The Republic military launched a prolonged siege of the seven Empress Teta worlds, eventually recapturing the system and scattering the Krath remnants. The same happened in the Tapani sector; with the help of [[House Pelagia|House]] Pelagia, the Jedi Order [[Cleansing of the Nine Houses|destroyed]] the Mecrosa Order sponsored by [[House Mecetti]]. Exar Kun's Sith Empire virtually ceased to exist.

After the Empire's collapse, some of its officials, leaders, and commanders went into hiding. Many retreated to the Outer Rim, near Korriban, which after the war remained under Sith control, waiting for the opportune moment to regain power. The Mandalorians managed to do it before them, starting the next great [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] in the galaxy. The Sith heirs of Kun's Empire finally had their chance when [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and [[Darth Malak]] established their new [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] in [[3959 BBY]].

==Government and Politics==
[[File:MandyTheExtremelyDomitableAndExarKun-TSW3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Exar Kun and Mandalore bursting through the doors of the Galactic Senate Hall.]]
The Sith Empire was a magocratic and theocratic state. Its leader was the Dark Lord of the Sith [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] alongside with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], another Sith Lord [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], who was his second-in-command, though this Sith Lord was quite independent regarding making political and military decisions. Other positions of power included [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]/Empress of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] (Ulic Qel-Droma, [[Aleema Keto]]), the [[Krath Council]] based in [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] (subordinates to the rulers of the Empress Teta system), [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], the Indomitable leader of the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] and Grand Master of the [[Mecrosa Order]] (High Lady [[Brezwalt III]]). These officials all led their own organizations in any way that pleased them, but were obliged to obey the orders issued by both Sith Lords.

Just like the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] protected the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Sith Empire had its own state religious body called the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]]. It consisted of the Jedi corrupted by [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], fallen Jedi, who joined of their own free will ([[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]) and various [[Sith Warrior]]s like [[Sith Marauder]]s. They were supported by the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cultists and [[Mecrosa Order]] assassins. The predecessor of the Sith Brotherhood was the [[Naddist]]s, a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] ruled by King and Queen of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], which was defeated before the establishment of the Sith Empire.

The spiritual leader of the Empire was the ancient Dark Lord of the Sith [[Freedon Nadd]], who had a big impact, both on the development of the Brotherhood of the Sith and Krath. However, his authority was challenged and he ceased to exist due to the actions of his successor.

[[File:Great_Sith_War_TOR_Timeline.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Sith Empire's forces fighting the Jedi]]
The main goal of the Empire was to overthrow the Republic and annihilate the Jedi Order, so its policy was to sow chaos and discord on a high level in the galaxy. Although its leaders based the new Empire on the model of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|ancient one]] and vowed to bring back the traditions of the [[Golden Age of the Sith]], destruction of their enemies was a top priority for them and was more important than gaining new territories like planets and hyperspace routes. While leading their campaigns, neither the Krath nor their Mandalorian allies had much interest in maintaining infrastructures or civil order. Therefore the Empire was known for its horrible atrocities, fondness for [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], genocidal actions and devastation of worlds. However its forces managed to conquer some Republic worlds and gain footholds in various parts of the galaxy. The Sith garrisons, under the command of a Sith Lord/Krath commander and composed of Krath soldiers and war droids were tasked with defending conquered and occupied territories.

The Empire used also, though rarely, diplomatic means. The most famous case is this, when it signed a non-aggression pact with the Hutts in the first year of the war.

The factions of the Empire divided responsibilities between each other. The Sith Brotherhood devoted most of its time and effort to fight the Jedi Order and was remembered in the history for planning and executing the methodical killing of famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], event which came to be known as the [[Sith uprising]]. The Mecrosa Order produced additional Force-using assassins. The Krath and Mandalorian Crusaders led military campaigns against the Republic mostly separately, but sometimes they took part in joint-military operations, including [[Battle of Foerost (Great Sith War)|Battle of Foerost]] and [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. Both factions carried on spectacular terrorist raids on Republic [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].

==Military==
[[File:TOR_Timeline010.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Exar Kun amassing his Massassi army.]]
The military forces of the Sith Empire was a mix of weapons of war battleships ([[The Force/Legends|Force]]-powered superweapons), battle droids and organic forces. The [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|commander-in-chief]] was Exar Kun, who approved strategic attacks. Brotherhood of the Sith, Krath and Mandalorians had their own command structure, but there was a coordinator between them - a fallen [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Ulic Qel-Droma. He was the second Sith Lord and Kun's apprentice, co-ruler of the Empress Teta system, supreme commander of the Krath military forces and honorary master to [[Mandalore the Indomitable]].

The army consisted mainly of well-trained soldiers and fighters, including [[Tetan shock trooper]]s, Krath troops, [[Mandalorian Crusaders]], [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] soldiers, [[Sith Marauder]]s, [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]], [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], [[Mecrosa Order]] assassins, and other [[Darksider]]s. There were also brainwashed followers, who participated in suicide missions, known as ([[Chaos trooper]]s). The Empire deployed also [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] like [[Krath war droid/Legends|Krath war droids]], designed to fight the Jedi, and [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]], produced and used by the Mandalorians. The creatures ([[silan]]s, [[Terentatek/Legends|terentateks]], [[Sith wyrm|giant wyrms]]) were also common in the armed forces of the Empire.

The fleet boasted [[Supremacy-class attack ship]]s, warships, [[Tetan Assault Ship]]s, [[CX-133 Chaos fighter]]s, [[Flying Decks]], Mandalorian starships ([[Kyramud-type battleship]]s, [[Shaadlar-type troopship]]s, [[Davaab-type starfighter]]s) and Republic warships stolen from the assaulted shipyards.

[[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] was a powerful military tool of the Empire. [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulets]], large-scale illusions, [[Sith sword|swords]], spellbooks and [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] sometimes decided the outcome of a duel or battle. The Sith also utilized [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] - notable examples were the [[Dark Reaper]] and [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']].

==Economy==
[[File:Exar_kun_massassi.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Exar Kun made Massassi people his obedient servants.]]
The Sith Empire had a very diverse economy, because its wealth and military power were built by four disparate factions. Exar Kun's Sith Empire was born out of war, so it placed their entire economic, industrial, and scientific capabilities at the service of the war effort.

The Brotherhood of the Sith, desiring to restore the traditions of the Golden Age of the Sith, planned to build the economic strength of their Sith Empire on the basis of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Just like the ancient Sith Lords, they believed that extensive use of slave labor, is one of many factors that gives the Empire a military and economic advantage. It can be assumed that some other species, besides the Massassi, were transformed into "willing" slaves by Sith magic, which could even corrupt powerful Force-users.

[[File:Miningoutpost.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Empress Teta's orbiting carbonite smelter]]
The Krath, whose leadership descended from the [[Tetan monarchy/Legends|Tetan Monarchy]], had the strongest and most developed economy. After the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Empress Teta system experienced vigorous economic development. It was well known in the galaxy as being a prominent producer of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], a mined ore that was an integral component in the manufacture of starship parts, most notably [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] engines. The [[Carbonite Guild]], a powerful and influential mining conglomerate associated with the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] and sharing rule over the system with the Tetan royalty, oversaw the production of this metal alloy. The system had also its own shipbuilding industry with [[Koros Spaceworks]] being the main Tetan starship manufacturer. After the violent coup, the Krath not only seized military and governmental control of the Empress Teta system, but also took control of the most important state-owned companies, using all their assets and resources to fund their military expansion in the galaxy. Being a Sith inspired cult, they legalized slavery and launched numerous military slave raids. It should be noted that some of Tetan technology was outdated and needed updates, which were eventually introduced by Ulic Qel-Droma.

Mandalorian Crusaders implemented a centrally planned economy. It was structured around clans, who administered land the way they pleased, but were obliged to gear all materials and resources towards war production, when general economic mobilization for war was announced by their warlord, [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]]. Mandalorian daily life was defined by conquests, so they exploited conquered worlds and species, though they respected alien technology and employed it to design new machines and weapons of war.

The Mecrosa Order was sponsored by House Mecetti, a coalition of noble families that ruled the [[Mecetti Province]], thus controlling the entire [[Leozi Route]] and a portion of [[Procopian Shipping Lane]]. House Mecetti, tainted by the dark side, sought to realize their imperialistic ambitions in the Tapani sector and establish a true Mecetti Empire. Disposing of the leaders of some [[Tapani Noble Houses|rival houses]] and absorbing their territories, Mecetti were very close to achieving their goals. Though they maintained an isolationist policy, they decided to financially contribute to Kun's Empire in order to further weaken the Galactic Republic. For example, Sith Lords were granted tax-free holdings on the world [[Nyssa]], where there was an ancient castle of the Mecrosa Order.

==Astrography==
During the Great Sith War, Exar Kun's Sith Empire's territory was spread across the whole known galaxy, stretching from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The following list includes worlds controlled by the various factions of this empire (Brotherhood of the Sith, Krath, Mandalorians, Mecrosa Order) as well as Republic planets conquered by Kun's forces at different times of the war.

==Behind the scenes==
The relation of the Sith Empire to the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] is not said, though both are mentioned separately in the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''.
